title: Potential Unbacked iTRY Minting via Yield Distribution Manipulation
description: The processAccumulatedYield() function distributes yield without sufficient validation, potentially allowing unbacked iTRY tokens to be minted through manipulation of the yield distribution mechanism.
impact: An attacker could potentially mint iTRY tokens that are not properly backed by collateral, undermining the 1:1 backing guarantee and potentially leading to loss of funds for legitimate users.
